🏛️ Rotary Friendship Exchange – Learning from Local Governance

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange with Argentina, a delegation of 10 Rotarians from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, visited the historic Teatro Municipal “Del Viejo Concejo” – Concejo Deliberante de San Isidro, Argentina.

The visit provided an excellent opportunity for the RFE delegates to gain an insight into the functioning of local government and civic administration. The delegation learned about the role of local governing bodies, their community-oriented initiatives, and various projects undertaken for the benefit and development of the local community.

The interaction offered a valuable exchange of ideas and perspectives on community development, civic responsibility and local governance, while giving the Indian Rotarians a deeper understanding of the systems and initiatives followed in San Isidro.

The visit was not only educational but also reflected the true spirit of Rotary Friendship Exchange—learning from one another, sharing experiences and building stronger international understanding.
